instructions.navigation_entry: Record label, href, kind, page_id or section_id, and generated_mockup_id. Kinds: designed page, anchor, existing shared documentation, external, download, action. Explain unchanged documentation boundaries.
instructions.page_entry: Record id, route, purpose, primary_action, content, required_states, selected_mockup_id, continuation_ids and implementation_comparison. Cover every designed navigation destination.
instructions.image_asset_entry: Record page/section, mockup region, standalone generated file, actual prompt, references, raw hash, dimensions, crop, palette, correction and inspected match. Include the depicted pose/gesture/gaze/props, visible subject bounds, overlap order and responsive placement. For cutouts link full-resolution light/dark/project-background reviews of the final export, not just alpha stats. Generate new/changed images separately before implementation; never crop from a UI mockup. Mark genuinely matching existing kit assets as reused. See fidelity-record.json for optional detailed evidence.
instructions.variation_entry: Record page_id, identity_constants, structural_axes, actual_prompt, actual_attachments and their hashes, raw_output and hash, generated_at, reviewed_at, observations, selected and selection_reason. Generate before implementation.
